shortDescription: Three newly created wallets have opened 20x leveraged long positions in Bitcoin and ETH, with an unrealized profit of $1.14 million. According to Odaily, Lookonchain said the wallets, which may belong to the same whale, hold 323.05 BTC valued at $19.54 million and 6,725 ETH valued at $11.4 million.
